facts: The event is a one-month hackathon addressing mental or physical health, with an optional AI focus.
Participants may enter individually or in teams of two to four, and no prior experience is required.
Submissions must build software intended to improve mental or physical wellbeing.
Tracks include AI/ML and responsible AI, and brain injury recovery.
A submission must include a GitHub repository with functioning source code and a video no longer than four minutes.
The listed prizes are in-kind subscriptions, domains, or courses; the page does not establish a cash prize.
Partners named on the page include Sprqs and Rutgers Synapse.

facts: Submissions run from August 7, 2026 at 12:00 PM EDT through September 4, 2026 at 11:45 PM EDT.
Public voting and judging run from September 5, 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT through September 11, 2026 at 11:45 PM EDT.
